purpose: Test whether the binary diagonal witnesses exposed by v5.3 collapse to one of the standard tractable Boolean relation classes. Freeze a 16-vertex smooth C4-only graph whose relation of successful diagonal selections is not bijunctive, affine, Horn or dual-Horn; the Horn failures persist under every independent relabelling of the two diagonals. This rules out local existential reductions of the visible switch relation to 2-SAT, XOR-SAT, Horn-SAT or dual-Horn-SAT.

finite_control.bit_convention: For sorted C4=(a,b,c,d), bit 0 contracts diagonal {a,c}; bit 1 contracts {b,d}.
finite_control.definition: A bit vector belongs to R_G exactly when the corresponding four diagonal contractions produce a 3-colourable quotient. By v5.3 this is also exactly the set of diagonal witness selections compatible with some 3-colouring of G.

bijunctive.fact: all three inputs lie in R_G but 0011 does not

affine.fact: all inputs lie in R_G but 1010 does not

horn.fact: inputs lie in R_G but their AND does not

dual_horn.fact: inputs lie in R_G but their OR does not

polymorphism_failures.renaming_control: The checker flips every subset of the four visible bits (all 16 independent choices of which physical diagonal is called 0/1) and verifies that no renamed relation is AND-closed or OR-closed. Majority and affine closure are invariant under coordinate complementation, so their failures already survive renaming.

theorem.name: C4_DIAGONAL_FEASIBILITY_DOES_NOT_PP_COLLAPSE_TO_THE_STANDARD_BOOLEAN_TRACTABLE_CLONES
theorem.statement: The frozen visible relation R_G is not primitive-positive/existentially definable from a bijunctive, affine, Horn or dual-Horn constraint language while preserving these four switch bits as the visible projection.
proof: Bijunctive relations are exactly the Boolean relations preserved by majority; conjunction and existential projection preserve a polymorphism. The explicit majority failure forbids a bijunctive/2-CNF realization.
Affine Boolean relations are preserved by ternary XOR; the explicit XOR failure forbids an affine/XOR-system realization.

Horn relations are preserved by AND and dual-Horn relations by OR; these polymorphisms are also preserved under conjunction and existential projection. The explicit failures forbid those pp realizations.
Because the semantic 0/1 labels of a C4 diagonal are arbitrary, the checker additionally rules out every coordinate-renamed Horn/dual-Horn version.

killed: Encode each C4 diagonal choice as one Boolean variable and expect all global feasibility information to become 2-SAT after adding polynomially many local existential Boolean auxiliaries.
The analogous direct collapse to linear XOR equations, Horn clauses, or dual-Horn clauses on the diagonal witnesses.
Argue tractability solely from each inner C4 contributing only one binary witness.
not_killed: A genuinely nonlocal algorithm that never materializes the full feasible-selection relation.
A richer tractable structure outside the four tested Boolean clones.
Graphic-AF3 cancellation using the Hamiltonian/tension coordinates rather than diagonal bits.

next_target.name: E8_C4_SWITCH_NONLOCAL_OR_GRAPHIC_AF3_CONTRACTION_V5_5
next_target.directive: Stop local tractable-clone encodings of diagonal bits. Any next C4-based route must use the Hamiltonian order and correlate multiple switches globally, or return to the equivalent graphic-AF3 tension space and derive a contraction there. Require polynomial state, exact decision and witness reconstruction.

source_note: The polymorphism characterization used here is the standard Boolean CSP/Schaefer theory. The finite graph relation and every closure failure are replayed exactly by the checker.
